entries.description: AWS managed in-memory caching service supporting engines including Valkey.

entries.description: Library for building user interfaces from reusable components.

entries.description: Programming language that adds static types to JavaScript.

entries.name: Chromatic
entries.description: Visual regression testing and review tool for detecting changes to user interfaces.

entries.name: JavaScript
entries.description: Programming language for web applications. On Hold for new work in the wehorse radar; TypeScript is in Adopt.

entries.name: AWS App Runner
entries.description: AWS service for deploying web applications from source code or container images.
entries.rationale: We are migrating these workloads to AWS ECS. Avoid new deployments on App Runner.

entries.name: AWS Elastic Beanstalk
entries.description: AWS service for deploying and managing web applications and their infrastructure.
entries.rationale: We are migrating these workloads to AWS ECS. Avoid new deployments on Elastic Beanstalk.

entries.name: Qodana
entries.description: JetBrains static code analysis platform for code quality and security checks.

entries.name: SonarQube
entries.description: Code analysis platform for code quality and security checks.

entries.name: Kanban
entries.description: Our current method for organizing and managing work. We use Kanban instead of Scrum.

entries.name: Scrum
entries.description: We have stopped using Scrum and now use Kanban to organize and manage our work.

entries.name: BigQuery
entries.description: We use BigQuery for data analytics.

entries.name: Codex
entries.description: We use Codex for AI-assisted software development.

entries.name: Claude Code
entries.description: We use Claude Code for AI-assisted software development.

entries.name: Terraform
entries.description: Our adopted infrastructure-as-code tool. We are gradually replacing AWS CloudFormation with Terraform over the long term.

entries.name: AWS CloudFormation
entries.description: AWS infrastructure-as-code service.
entries.rationale: We are gradually replacing CloudFormation with Terraform. Existing stacks remain in use during the transition.

entries.name: Elasticsearch
entries.description: Search and analytics engine.
entries.rationale: We completed the migration to OpenSearch, which now handles our search workloads.

entries.name: OpenSearch
entries.description: Our adopted search engine, replacing Elasticsearch. The migration is complete.

entries.name: Appium
entries.description: Automation framework for mobile end-to-end tests, with WebdriverIO as our test runner.
entries.rationale: We are trialing this setup in real projects. It is not yet fully adopted.

entries.name: AWS Kinesis Data Streams
entries.description: Newly introduced for streaming event data.

entries.name: Expo
entries.description: We have phased out Expo and no longer actively use it. It is on Hold for new work.

entries.name: AWS Lambda
entries.description: An adopted service for running functions without managing servers. We have had good experience with AWS Lambda.

entries.name: AWS Step Functions
entries.description: An adopted service for coordinating workflows. We have had very good experience with AWS Step Functions.

entries.name: AWS Glue
entries.description: An adopted and heavily used service for data integration and ETL.

entries.name: AWS RDS
entries.description: We use AWS RDS to host relational databases, including MySQL and PostgreSQL.

entries.name: MySQL
entries.description: One of our adopted relational database engines, used with AWS RDS.

entries.name: PostgreSQL
entries.description: One of our adopted relational database engines, used with AWS RDS.

entries.name: GitHub
entries.description: We actively use GitHub for source code hosting and collaboration alongside Bitbucket.

entries.name: Bitbucket
entries.description: We actively use Bitbucket for source code hosting and collaboration alongside GitHub.

entries.name: FrankenPHP
entries.description: PHP application server.
entries.rationale: Our standard for every new PHP application.

entries.name: Docker
entries.description: Fully adopted for building and running containerized applications.

entries.name: Angular
entries.description: Framework for building web applications.
entries.rationale: Adopted for our internal admin user interfaces.

entries.description: Our go-to CI/CD service for building, checking, and delivering applications.

entries.name: Symfony Messenger
entries.description: Our go-to component for message handling and asynchronous processing.

entries.name: Doctrine ORM
entries.description: Our adopted object-relational mapper for PHP applications.

entries.name: PHPStan
entries.description: Our go-to tool for static analysis of PHP code.

entries.name: PHPUnit
entries.description: Our go-to framework for automated PHP testing.

entries.description: AWS service for interactive video streaming.
